assertion.statement: external-secrets 0.16.0 adds a refreshPolicy field (CreatedOnce, Periodic or OnChange) to the ExternalSecret spec, and to ClusterExternalSecret's spec.externalSecretSpec, to control how the Secret is synchronized.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The new field is optional and opt-in. The evidence does not say how existing ExternalSecrets that leave it unset behave, so no exposure condition can be stated.; consequence: The release note only says the field was added. The note appears under a 'BREAKING CHANGES › What's Changed' heading, but no text says what breaks. The default behaviour when the field is unset is not in the evidence.
